title: Saline Flush Unit Rate — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Observation and Emergency Accounts
content:
The saline flush (code A4216 under revenue code 0270), on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), carries a rate per counted unit of:

| Payer class | Rate |
|---|---|
| Commercial HMO Claim | 1.10 USD |
| Commercial PPO Claim | 1.35 USD |
| otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) | its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage |

It is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units. Example (hypothetical): 6 units on a Commercial PPO Claim, charges 24.00 → 8.10.
